title: openapi-cli4ai catalog profile
description: A maintainer- or community-contributed API profile for the openapi-cli4ai catalog. One profile per file. Never inline secrets — reference them via *_env_var fields.

name.description: Catalog slug (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). Must match the file name without extension.

description.description: One factual line describing what the API is. No marketing copy.

maintainer.description: GitHub username of the person submitting and maintaining this profile.

source.description: Official developer or documentation URL for the API. Used for the ownership check (must share a registrable domain with base_url).

openapi_url.description: Absolute URL to the OpenAPI spec. Provide this or openapi_path.

openapi_path.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec relative to base_url. Provide this or openapi_url.

type.description: Auth strategy. Type-specific fields (e.g. env_var, header, token_url, issuer_url) are allowed. Secrets must be referenced by env var name, never inlined.
